title.narrative: Contract Management and Procurement of Medical, Non-Medical and Laboratory Equipment in Honduras

description.narrative: Together with the Pan American Health Organization, UNOPS is supporting the UN Development Programme in its efforts to strengthen the government of Honduras’ response to COVID-19. The $13.3 million programme funded by Inter-American Development Bank will help strengthen the healthcare system by providing much-needed supplies, material and equipment. UNOPS is responsible for procuring medical equipment, industrial hospital equipment and ambulances.
